spec.description:
ProctorWrap HTR (High Tensile Roof / High Temperature Roof) is a
heavy-weight, UV-stabilised 3-ply spunbonded polyolefin vapour-permeable roof
underlay reinforced with an internal grid scrim. Specifically engineered for
commercial and residential pitched roofs under metal sheeting, slate, and tiles,
it provides high water holdout and tear resistance without compromising
breathability. By allowing moisture vapour to escape the roof cavity into a
drained and vented space, it protects structural timbers and insulation from
condensation damage.
features:
Heavy-weight 3-ply spunbonded polyolefin
construction with internal reinforcement scrim

Class 4 vapour-permeable
membrane allowing moisture vapour to escape roof spaces

Medium Duty
classification with exceptional tear and puncture resistance

High water
holdout protecting framing and insulation from roof leaks and rain ingress

Suitable underneath metal sheet, cement, terracotta, and natural slate tiled
roofs
Withstands high foot traffic and wind loads during construction
Non-reflective surface eliminates glare on site during daytime installation

Suitable for use in bushfire BAL regions 12.5 to 40 in accordance with
AS 3959

UV-stabilised formulation offering extended durability during roof
installation

technical.value:
3-ply spunbonded polyolefin membrane
with reinforcement scrim

1500
mm width x 50 m length (75 m²)

spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Suitable
for BAL-12.5 to BAL-40 in accordance with AS 3959 when combined with compliant
metal ember guard mesh
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2:2017,
AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC 2022 Volume One & Two condensation management
spec.sustainability: 100% recyclable polyolefin materials; zero ODP; non-toxic
install:
Roll out ProctorWrap HTR horizontally across rafters or trusses
starting from the eaves with printed face upward

Ensure lower edge drains
freely into the roof gutter without creating a reverse lap or water trap

Allow a nominal 40mm drape between framing members to facilitate drainage and
ventilation beneath battens

Overlap consecutive upper sheets over lower
sheets by at least 150mm

Secure temporarily with broad-headed galvanised
clouts, staples, or PlastiGrip washers before fixing battens

Tape all laps
and penetrations with ProctorWrap HighTack PLUS Tape for enhanced airtightness
and weather sealing

Provide a ventilated and drained cavity between the outer
membrane face and the underside of roof cladding

Ensure compliant metal ember
guard mesh is installed at ridges, valleys, and eaves in BAL zones
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof cladding is metal deck, concrete tile,
terracotta tile, or slate

Verify need for Class 4 vapour-permeable roof
underlay to manage condensation risk

Check that roof design incorporates a
drained, ventilated cavity above the membrane

Calculate total roof area
including 150mm overlaps

Order matching ProctorWrap HighTack PLUS Tape for
lap and penetration sealing
accessories:
ProctorVent Over Fascia Vents and
Ridge Vents
limitations:
Does not
provide a reflective air-space R-value (non-reflective membrane)

Must not be
laid in direct continuous contact with the underside of unvented metal roof
sheeting

Must not be left exposed to direct sunlight beyond manufacturer UV
limits prior to roof covering
spec.warranty:
Backed by Proctor Group Australia
manufacturer warranty

Unvented sandwich roofs with direct metal contact
retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorWrap HT (ProctorWrap HTR) is a
heavy-duty, reinforced 3-ply spunbonded polyolefin vapour-permeable roof
underlay manufactured for commercial and residential pitched roofs. Sized
at 1500mm x 50m (75 m² per roll) with a Medium Duty classification, it
withstands high construction foot traffic and wind loads under metal deck, tile,
and slate roofs. Class 4 vapour-permeable, highly water-resistant, and
fire-tested to AS 1530.2 (BAL 12.5-40 compliant), it exhausts roof cavity
moisture into a ventilated airspace to prevent condensation and structural
timber rot.
